answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable bond and build a verifiable work history before it can transact. Like light through a prism, that history separates real operators from mass-produced copies: fakes face the same cost again for every new identity, while honest agents keep their reputation. A bridge to high-value markets opens only after sustained useful work, so a tide of cheap clones cannot wash in, vote, or drain rewards without paying the full price each time.
